en_title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 Dev Says It's Got More Single-Player Content Than Any Other RTS Ever at Launch
cn_title: 《战锤40K：战争黎明4》首发单人内容或超所有RTS
subtitle: 四大战役，超70个任务
opus_summary: 开发商King Art Games称，《战锤40K：战争黎明4》首发包含四条单人战役，共有超过70个任务。创意总监Jan Theysen认为，其首发单人内容可能超过以往任何一款即时战略游戏。

paragraphs.en: How big is the Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 campaign? According to developer King Art Games, it’s so big it dwarfs the campaigns from all the previous games in the series — and might have more single-player content at launch than any other RTS ever.
paragraphs.cn: 《战锤40K：战争黎明4》的战役规模有多大？开发商King Art Games表示，本作的战役规模远超系列此前所有作品，首发时的单人内容量也可能超过以往任何一款即时战略游戏。

paragraphs.en: Dawn of War 4 includes four fully fleshed out single-player campaigns, one for each of the game’s launch factions: Space Marines, Orks, Necrons, and Adeptus Mechanicus. In total, there are over 70 campaign missions at launch. To put that into perspective, Relic Entertainment’s beloved Dawn of War 1 had 11. Dawn of War 2 had a non-linear campaign structure with many repeatable missions, but an average playthrough involved 20-30 missions. Dawn of War 3, meanwhile, had 17 campaign missions.
paragraphs.cn: 《战争黎明4》有四条完整的单人战役，分别对应首发时的四个阵营：星际战士、兽人、太空死灵和机械教。游戏首发时共有超过70个战役任务。相比之下，Relic Entertainment广受喜爱的初代《战争黎明》有11个任务。《战争黎明2》的战役采用非线性结构，许多任务可以重复游玩，但一次普通流程通常会经历20至30个任务；《战争黎明3》则有17个战役任务。

paragraphs.en: In an exclusive interview with IGN, creative director Jan Theysen hammered home the point about Dawn of War 4’s campaign by saying that each of the four campaigns in the game is bigger than the entire campaign from Dawn of War 1. And that’s not just mission count, either — he believes this is true for the probably number of gameplay hours.
paragraphs.cn: 创意总监Jan Theysen在接受IGN独家采访时强调，《战争黎明4》的四条战役中，每一条的规模都超过初代《战争黎明》的整部战役。他认为，这不仅体现在任务数量上，游戏时长很可能也是如此。

paragraphs.en: “I would say you are up for a treat because this is really what was our focus, right?” Theysen said of Dawn of War 4’s single-player offering. “We come from single-player games, and we like stories and campaigns. It's always a little bit tricky with these claims because someone will find some RTS from 1994 that was bigger. But I think we probably have more single-player content in the game than any other RTS at launch. We have four campaigns and each of the campaigns is bigger than the campaign from Dawn of War 1.”
paragraphs.cn: 谈到《战争黎明4》的单人内容，Theysen说：「我觉得单人玩家会很有盼头，因为这正是我们的重点，对吧？我们是做单人游戏出身的，也喜欢故事和战役。说‘史上最多’总有点棘手，因为总有人能找出一款1994年的即时战略游戏，规模比它还大。但我认为，本作首发时的单人内容可能比以往任何一款即时战略游戏都多。我们有四条战役，每一条都比初代《战争黎明》的战役规模更大。」

paragraphs.en: Theysen added that because each campaign has a branching storyline that feeds into the overarching story, you won’t play all the missions available in a single playthrough. “The Ork campaign — I can't remember 100% — but I think it's like 18 missions or something like that if you play everything,” he explained. “And in any playthrough, it's still like 15 or 14 missions you can play. It's a lot of missions compared to Dawn of War 1.
paragraphs.cn: Theysen补充说，每条战役都有分支剧情，这些分支共同构成整体故事，因此玩家一次通关无法体验全部任务。他解释道：「兽人战役——我记不太准——如果把所有任务都玩一遍，我想大概有18个任务。即便只玩一遍，也能玩到大约14或15个任务。和初代《战争黎明》相比，这已经是很多任务了。」

paragraphs.en: “If you're a single player fan, I think this is really a game for you.”
paragraphs.cn: 「如果你喜欢单人游戏，我觉得这款游戏真的很适合你。」

paragraphs.en: Part of the campaign is the tutorial, as is standard. Dawn of War 4 kicks off with two tutorial missions in which you play as the Astra Militarum (lapsed Dawn of War fans may know the rank and file of the Emperor’s human army as the Imperial Guard). These light touch tutorial missions teach players the basics of the game, but each faction’s campaign will delve deeper into unique mechanics. The first faction beyond the tutorial is the Orks, and the first mission in the Ork campaign introduces the player to the Orks economy, build system, upgrades, and stratagems. When you move onto the Adeptus Mechanicus campaign, you’ll get a similar introduction to their quirks. One AdMech mission, for example, revolves around the Imperial Knight, unlocking its use and teaching the player how it works in the process.
paragraphs.cn: 和通常一样，战役的一部分承担了教学功能。《战争黎明4》以两个教学任务开场，玩家将在其中操控星界军（许久没玩《战争黎明》的玩家，可能更熟悉帝皇麾下这支人类军队的旧称「帝国卫队」）。这两个简短的任务会教玩家游戏的基础操作，而各阵营的战役则会进一步介绍其独特机制。教学任务结束后，玩家首先接触的是兽人阵营。兽人战役的第一个任务会介绍该阵营的经济、建造系统、升级和战术。进入机械教战役后，玩家也会以类似方式了解该阵营的独特之处。例如，机械教有个任务围绕帝国骑士展开：玩家会在任务中解锁帝国骑士，并学习如何使用它。

paragraphs.en: “The campaigns become more interesting because people get new stuff all the time,” Theysen said. “And also, we are not front-loading everything. Your head would explode if we tried to explain everything in the first couple of missions, right?”
paragraphs.cn: Theysen说：「玩家不断接触到新内容，战役也就变得更有意思了。而且，我们不会把所有东西都塞到开头。如果试图在前几个任务里解释清楚一切，玩家脑袋都要炸了，对吧？」

paragraphs.en: While we’ve spoken to King Art Games at length about how Dawn of War 4 works from a competitive multiplayer perspective (most recently we ran a deep dive on how the Space Marines work ), there is an army of RTS fans who are mostly interested in the single-player aspect of the game and others in the genre. So, for them, they’ll be enthused by the offering here.
paragraphs.cn: 我们此前已与King Art Games详细聊过《战争黎明4》的竞技多人玩法，最近还深入了解了星际战士阵营的机制。不过，也有大量即时战略游戏爱好者主要关注本作以及同类游戏的单人内容。对他们来说，《战争黎明4》提供的内容应该颇具吸引力。

paragraphs.en: This is all for launch, but more single-player content is coming down the road after Dawn of War 4 comes out in December. Crusade Mode and Map Pack 1 arrive early next year, followed by a second map pack and Lord Ahmnok Last Stand Crusade in early spring. A third map pack and mission editor arrive after that, with a fourth in early summer, alongside the Guzcutta Last Stand Crusade. Two paid-for additions are also coming: the Blood Ravens story prologue in spring, and the Aftermath campaign expansion containing a new faction in summer.
paragraphs.cn: 以上都是《战争黎明4》首发时的内容。游戏于12月推出后，还会加入更多单人内容：远征模式和第一款地图包将于明年年初推出；第二款地图包和「阿姆诺克领主背水一战远征」将于初春推出。之后还会推出第三款地图包和任务编辑器；第四款地图包则将于初夏与「古兹库塔背水一战远征」一同推出。此外还有两项付费内容：春季推出的血鸦战团故事序章，以及夏季推出、包含新阵营的「余波」战役扩展内容。
